intro.label: Who we are
intro.text: Live to Smile Foundation is a Kasaragod-based charitable organisation serving food, shelter, education and care to people who need it most. Through Hunger Free Kasaragod we deliver fresh breakfasts, grocery kits and rescued celebration food across Kasaragod, Cherkala and Kanhangad, and into remote villages that urban aid often overlooks.

story.label: Our story
story.heading: How it started, and where we are today

day.label: A day with us
day.heading: From first light to late evening
day.dawnBody: Before the city wakes, fresh breakfasts are served to people living on the streets of Kasaragod, Cherkala and Kanhangad.
day.middayBody: Grocery kits travel to 100 households in remote villages, and Food On Call answers families that urban aid overlooks.
day.eveningBody: As weddings and birthdays wind down, surplus food is collected, packed and kept cold for the next distribution.

programs.label: What we do
programs.heading: Nine programs, one promise
programs.sub: Every program starts from the same idea: food and care, served with dignity.

rescue.label: Celebrating Together
rescue.heading: Your celebration can feed a neighbourhood
rescue.sub: Weddings and birthdays often end with good food left over. We make sure it reaches people who need it, safely.
rescue.collectBody: Our team arrives promptly, transfers unserved dishes into food-grade containers, and keeps them safe and fresh.
rescue.packBody: Food is organised into eco-friendly, ready-to-eat meal packets.
rescue.distributeBody: Dedicated vehicles and a refrigerated hub keep food at the right temperature for same-day or next-day delivery.
rescue.safe: Kept cold in our refrigerated hub

ledger.heading: The distribution ledger

impactHub.whatsappText: Hunger Free Kasaragod serves free meals and grocery kits across Kasaragod. See how you can help:

donate.label: Donate
donate.heading: Feed someone in Kasaragod today
donate.customBody: Choose what feels right for you. Every rupee goes toward meals and grocery kits.

share.label: Share your moment
share.heading: Celebrated with a meal? Tell us about it.
share.body: Served breakfast, sponsored a day or gave your wedding's surplus food? Share a photo and a few words. Every submission is reviewed before it appears.

finalCta.heading: No one in Kasaragod should sleep hungry.
finalCta.body: A wedding feast, a birthday cake, a month of groceries. Whatever you can share, someone in Kasaragod is waiting for it.
